what: The sanctioned remedy for BL-20260730-PR-CI-NOT-ATTACHING is a manual workflow_dispatch of guards/pytest-run/pytest-collect. Measured on PR #10215 (2026-08-24): a dispatched guards run reports the SAME headline as a pull_request run -- 'PASS 50 FAIL 0 SKIP 0' followed by 'All relevant guards passed' -- while having scanned THREE FEWER guards. The run footer says so ('NOT SCANNED on this event (3) -- no PR diff to scope by'): api-tier-policy-guard, test-schema-fidelity-guard and diagnostic-provenance-guard consume the {pr_diff} template variable, which is empty on a non-pull_request event. So the workaround for a bug whose whole danger is 'a check that silently did not run renders identically to green' itself renders a reduced scan identically to a full one, in the headline a reader quotes.
